title: Your 3 Birthdays With Me
subtitle: A little book of us
dedication: For you, my love — every page is yours

entries.title: The first candle
entries.text: Our very first birthday together. I was so nervous to get it right — and you smiled like I'd given you the world.
entries.caption: The night it all felt real

entries.title: Cake on your nose
entries.text: You laughed so hard you couldn't blow the candles out. I've never loved a mess more.
entries.caption: Still my favourite photo

entries.title: Our little traditions
entries.text: Late-night walks, hot chocolate, and you stealing my scarf. That's when I knew these were our things now.

entries.title: One year braver
entries.text: A whole year of us. You were a little more you, and I was a little more in love.
entries.caption: Birthday number two

entries.title: The surprise that almost wasn't
entries.text: You nearly caught me planning it — twice. The look on your face was worth every close call.

entries.title: Everywhere with you
entries.text: New places, same hand in mine. Every trip is better because you're the one next to me.
entries.caption: Lost, but together

entries.title: Ordinary days
entries.text: Sunday mornings, coffee in bed, your sleepy voice. The small things turned out to be the big things.

entries.title: Our third candle
entries.text: Three birthdays together. Three chances to tell you that you are the best thing in my life.
entries.caption: Three and counting

entries.title: What you've taught me
entries.text: Patience. Kindness. How to laugh at myself. You've made me a better man without ever asking me to change.

entries.title: And now, London
entries.text: This birthday isn't a page yet — it's the one we're about to write. Pack your bags, beautiful.
entries.caption: The next page starts here

closing.title: To be continued…
closing.text: Three birthdays down, a lifetime to go. I can't wait to fill the next book with you.
